headline: Flood pump station upgrades and enforcement orders at 5 Appleton Street, 461 Northampton Street, and 98 Lower Westfield Road.
summary: A notice of intent from the city's Engineering Department covers electrical upgrades and building repairs at flood pump stations. Three enforcement orders involve cutting trees near a resource area, grading along the Connecticut River, and dumping near Tannery Brook.
items: Request for Determination of Applicability from Berkshire and Eastern Railroad: confirm wetland boundaries along the BERX Connecticut River Line right-of-way in Holyoke, part of a five-year vegetation management plan

Notice of Intent (continued from 10/22/26) from City of Holyoke Engineering Department: electrical upgrades at Flood Pump Stations #1 through #7, sluice gate actuator replacements at Tailrace Structure #6 and Tailrace Intake and Gatehouse Structures #24, and limited building envelope repairs at Flood Pump Stations #5 through #7
Enforcement Order (continued from 10/22/26) at 5 Appleton Street (MBP: 049-01-006): grading and fill along about 470 lineal feet of banks near the Connecticut River
Enforcement Order (continued from 10/08/26) at 461 Northampton Street (MBP: 223-00-011): tree and shrub removal and a wood chip pile in the 100' buffer zone
Enforcement Order at 98 Lower Westfield Road (MBP: 174-00-021): illegal dumping and altering of a bordering vegetated wetland within the 200' buffer of Tannery Brook
Formal vote on minutes from 10/22/26 meeting
Discussion of department goal: education for property owners in buffer zones of resource areas
Discussion of a coffee hour hosted by the Conservation Department
Discussion of upcoming items for the 12/10/26 meeting
Mail and other items not reasonably anticipated by the Chair

### Holyoke Conservation Commission

6:15 PM**

Contact Sean Mullen for questions about meeting access: mullens@holyoke.org or 413-322-5610

(All meetings are recorded)

1. Call to Order
2. Request for Determination of Applicability
   - Applicant: Berkshire and Eastern Railroad
   - Representative: VHB
   - Location: Multiple Sites
   - Description: Confirmation boundaries of wetland resource areas adjacent to the BERX Connecticut River Line railroad right-of-way in Holyoke as part of the railroad's five-year Vegetation Management Plan.
3. Notice of Intent – Continued from 10/22/26
   - Applicant: City of Holyoke, Engineering Department
   - Representative: Tighe and Bond
   - Location: Multiple Sites
   - Description: The proposed project includes electrical upgrades to the existing Flood Pump Stations #1 through #7, sluice gate actuator replacements at Tailrace Structure #6 and the Tailrace Intake and Gatehouse Structures #24, as well as limited building envelope repairs at Flood Pump Stations #5 through #7.
4. Enforcement Order – Continued from 10/22/26
   - Location: 5 Appleton Street (MBP: 049-01-006)
   - Description: Grading and fill deposition along approximately 470 lineal feet of banks within Riverfront, Banks, and Priority and Estimated Habitats of Rare Species associated with the Connecticut River. Fill sediments and associated debris were observed eroding down the steep bank towards the water.
5. Enforcement Order - Continued from 10/08/26
   - Location: 461 Northampton Street (MBP: 223-00-011)
   - Description: Removal of tree and potentially shrubs in the 100' buffer zone of a resource area. Large chipper staged in 100' buffer zone and created large pile of wood chips measuring approximately 20'(L)x6'(W)x6'(H) in 100' buffer zone
6. Enforcement Order
   - Location: 98 Lower Westfield Road (MBP: 174-00-021)
   - Description: Illegal dumping and altering of bordering vegetated wetland within the 200' buffer of Tannery Brook
7. Formal Vote – Minutes from 10/22/26 meeting
8. Discussion - Department Goal: Education to Property Owners in Buffer of Resource Areas
9. Discussion – Coffee Hour hosted by Conservation Department
10. Discussion – Upcoming Items for 12/10/26 Meeting
11. Mail/other items not reasonably anticipated by the Chair
12. Adjourn
